subject: Paleontologist, and T-Rex Group Shot
prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated style. Ultra-bright, high-noon sunny lighting in a vibrant museum research lab. A friendly Paleontologist is happily staring at a cracked dinosaur egg on a lab table. The crack has revealed a baby Ankylosaurus.  A lab table contains an SEM microscope and a portable CT Scanner. A poster of a Triceratops hangs on the lab wall in the background. Saturation is high with vivid greens and warm golden light. Caption in the upper third: 'Dino Tools!' in bright red, thick 3D mixed-case block letters with a glossy finish. A second caption in the bottom third: ‘Player Wins!’  Organic skin and feather textures. No shadows on faces; extremely well-lit and cheerful.
visual_logic: Matches the exact brightness, saturation, and 'Success' energy of the Player Wins card to create a cohesive brand look.
lighting_recommendation: Ultra-bright, high-noon sunny lighting (specific to this asset)
